NEEDS_FIX: YES
<assessment>SOURCE exterior panels share a recessed rectangular core, two upper glazed buffer levels, three descending ramp runs at the short end, and an elevated concave roof with unequal edge heights. Ground-level panels show concrete columns and projecting steel walkway supports; interior panels show a pale timber ceiling, light floors and guarded circular openings. Plans and sections additionally establish internal partitions and double-height regions. CURRENT captures the principal roof profile and layered arrangement, but ramp extents, facade/guard assembly and exposed floor openings differ visibly. CURRENT exterior views cannot verify the source’s internal section arrangement or concealed joints; no numerical dimensions are confirmed by these images.</assessment>
<issue priority="1" view="坡道端">problem: SOURCE images 1–2 place the upper ramp runs and landings largely within the outer glazed end’s width. CURRENT images 15–16 extend both upper runs and their return landings substantially beyond its corners, widening the circulation silhouette.
action: Locally shorten and reposition the upper runs and landings to match the source’s inset endpoints, retaining their descending arrangement. Ensure each landing connects continuously to its corresponding perimeter walkway.</issue>
<issue priority="2" view="端部与长边">problem: SOURCE images 1–3 show a fine, pale outer frame and mesh guards with visually distinct glazing behind. CURRENT images 16–17 instead read as repeated heavy dark horizontal rails; ramp guards are open bars, and the source’s mesh infill is absent.
action: Correct the visible frame and guard sections and finishes, add the source-backed mesh infill, and preserve the separation between glazing, guards and walkway edges.</issue>
<issue priority="3" view="顶层室内">problem: SOURCE image 4 shows circular floor openings enclosed by raised mesh guards. CURRENT image 18 exposes two circular openings with no surrounding guards; the distant guarded stair opening does not resolve these omissions.
action: Add fitted circular mesh guards around the two exposed openings, connected to their floor rims, using the source’s slender pale construction.</issue>
<keep>Concave roof end profile with one edge higher than the other.
Three descending ramp runs at the short end.
Recessed ground-level column line beneath the projecting perimeter walkway.</keep>
